title: Conjecture 3.19 — Rohrlich
exact_target: Are the gamma functional equations, reflection and multiplication relations the complete multiplicative relations among normalized gamma values at rational nonintegral points, after allowing division by two?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8700037 (AMR-086-0037). CC BY 4.0.
